notes.title: Curtains 1.19 Now Available
notes.notes:
Stardock is pleased to announce the release of Curtains v1.19 today on Steam. As always, existing users should grab the update from within the app itself.

Changes include:
[list]
[*] Fixed a repaint issue with the taskbar which prevents Curtains from interfering with other taskbar controlling applications when taskbar skinning is disabled (requires a reboot after changing).
[*] Fixed a problem with the background part of the ribbon when in glass mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Stardock releases v1.1 for Curtains, the popular Windows customization app
notes.notes:
Stardock released a v1.1 update for Curtains today. One of Stardock’s newest customization tools, Curtains allows users to apply new styles along the lines of Dark Mode and Light to Windows 10.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38452092/e6a0f04d8360cc22d364556cf4f06472c667df14.jpg[/img]

Taking advantage of the groundwork built to support light and dark mode, Curtains includes several unique styles that enhance the look and feel of the Windows UI along with apps that already support light and dark mode.  

"The advantage of using a program like Curtains is that it's essentially just adding new 'modes' to Windows," said Brad Wardell, CEO of Stardock.  "It works with high DPI displays and your existing programs. This gives users a little extra touch of customizing the Windows experience."

Users can easily create and share their own styles using the built in style editor.  A Curtains style can change everything that Light and Dark mode can change, including the Start button, title bar buttons, and title bar coloring. It also supports tweaking gradients, shadows opacity, and hundreds of other small elements of the Windows GUI.

The newest version of Curtains adds a major new feature for Explorer background transparency and blur effects. While the new option only comes standard with certain styles in the app, users can edit other styles and apply the blur and transparency effects themselves for further customization. 

A new option to extend the title bar ribbon in Explorer windows also adds an extra layer of customization for those who enjoy editing every detail of their Windows experience. v1.1 also introduces several quality of life improvements and increased style application speed.

notes.title: Curtains - Add New Style Modes to Windows 10
notes.notes:
[h1]Add Additional Style Modes to Windows 10 with Curtains[/h1]
https://youtu.be/HzYe08U787g
Stardock released its newest customization tool on Steam today. Curtains™ allows users to apply new styles along the lines of Dark Mode and Light to Windows® 10.

Taking advantage of the groundwork built to support light and dark mode, Curtains includes several new styles including Fluent, Cairo, and Crystal mode that enhance the look and feel of the Windows UI along with apps that already support light and dark mode.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38452092/7da024f7b696a7ee1272790c9f8ba34e580272d5.png[/img]

"The advantage of using a program like Curtains is that it's essentially just adding new 'modes' to Windows," said Brad Wardell, CEO of Stardock. "It already works with high DPI displays and your existing programs.  This gives users a little extra touch of customizing the Windows experience."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38452092/8a6513a12961cefd3e4b16fab932aaea8d87b00f.png[/img]

In addition, Curtains also includes styles that allow users to switch Windows to looking more like Windows XP or Windows 95 as well as alternative operating systems.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1250070

Users can easily create and share their own styles using the built in style editor.  A Curtains style can change everything that Light and Dark mode can change, including the Start button, title bar buttons, and title bar coloring. It also supports tweaking gradients, shadows opacity, and hundreds of other small elements of the Windows GUI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38452092/7b469ddf2aa4b111d6328b545e2d2b042831d0ec.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38452092/95f8fbfdcd81daed2de059c0afb64566122237d2.png[/img]

"Curtains makes it very easy for people to make their own styles," said Wardell. "There are a lot of customization features that have been buried in recent years such as font faces and sizes, detailed color choices and much more. Curtains allows people to adjust all of that and save it with their style easily.”
